headline: Arrested OpenAI Engineer Booked a One-Way Ticket to Saudi Arabia
headline_vi: Một kỹ sư của OpenAI bị bắt giữ đã đặt vé một đường đến Saudi Arabia
summary: The OpenAI employee who was arrested and charged with allegedly using a hidden recording device in one of the ChatGPT maker’s San Francisco offices had a one-way ticket to Saudi Arabia booked for Oct. 12, according to a court filing.
